steps.name: collectSummoningKey
steps.summary: Obtain the Summoning Key from the spawn area.
notes: In the spawn area, become the Beast by using a purple Flame Fountain.
Melee the wooden crate on the truck to reveal the Summoning Key.
Return to human form and pick up the Summoning Key.
The Summoning Key in the spawn area.

steps.name: openRift
steps.summary: Open access to the Rift area by breaking the glowing doors.
notes: Use Beast Mode to break the glowing doors with the Mark of the Beast around the map.
There are three doors: one in each district (Canals, Waterfront, Footlight).
Breaking at least one door allows access to the Rift.

steps.name: theMagicianItem
steps.summary: Obtain The Magician's ritual item: The Lawyer's Pen.
notes: In Beast Mode, shock the crane's electrical box near Easy Street to lower the crate.
The crate will drop and break, revealing the Lawyer's Pen.
Return to human form and pick up the Pen.

steps.name: theMagicianRitualSiteAccess
steps.summary: Open access to The Magician's ritual site.
notes: Use Beast Mode to grapple up to the ledge above Easy Street.
Melee the door to open the ritual site.

steps.name: theMagicianRitual
steps.summary: Complete The Magician's ritual to obtain the Gateworm.
notes: Go to the ritual site above Easy Street.
Place the Lawyer's Pen and the Summoning Key on the altar to start the ritual.
Survive until the ritual is complete to obtain the Gateworm.

steps.name: theDetectiveItem
steps.summary: Obtain The Detective's ritual item: The Detective's Badge.
notes: In the Canal District, enter Beast Mode.
Melee the box behind the grate in the canal to reveal the Badge.
Shock the electrical box hidden behind a breakable wall to open the grate.
Return to human form and pick up the Badge.

steps.name: theDetectiveRitualSiteAccess
steps.summary: Open access to The Detective's ritual site.
notes: Use Beast Mode to lower the stairs to the Ruby Rabbit nightclub.
Shock the electrical box to open the door.

steps.name: theDetectiveRitual
steps.summary: Complete The Detective's ritual to obtain the Gateworm.
notes: Go to the Ruby Rabbit nightclub.
Place the Detective's Badge and the Summoning Key on the altar.
Survive the ritual to obtain the Gateworm.

steps.name: theBoxerItem
steps.summary: Obtain The Boxer's ritual item: The Championship Belt.
notes: In the Waterfront District, enter Beast Mode.
Grapple to the walkway above and melee the crate hanging from the chain.
The crate will fall, revealing the Championship Belt.
Return to human form and pick up the Belt.

steps.name: theBoxerRitualSiteAccess
steps.summary: Open access to The Boxer's ritual site.
notes: Use Beast Mode to open the door to The Anvil Boxing Gym.
Shock the electrical box to power the door.

steps.name: theBoxerRitual
steps.summary: Complete The Boxer's ritual to obtain the Gateworm.
notes: Go to The Anvil Boxing Gym.
Place the Championship Belt and the Summoning Key on the altar.
Survive the ritual to obtain the Gateworm.

steps.name: theFemmeFataleItem
steps.summary: Obtain The Femme Fatale's ritual item: The Producer's Toupee.
notes: In the Footlight District, enter Beast Mode.
Grapple across the gap to the ledge and melee the crate.
The crate will fall, revealing the Producer's Toupee.
Return to human form and pick up the Toupee.

steps.name: theFemmeFataleRitualSiteAccess
steps.summary: Open access to The Femme Fatale's ritual site.
notes: Use Beast Mode to open the door to The Black Lace Burlesque.
Shock the electrical box to power the door.

steps.name: theFemmeFataleRitual
steps.summary: Complete The Femme Fatale's ritual to obtain the Gateworm.
notes: Go to The Black Lace Burlesque.
Place the Producer's Toupee and the Summoning Key on the altar.
Survive the ritual to obtain the Gateworm.

steps.name: accessSacredPlace
steps.summary: Open the Sacred Place in the Rift area.
notes: Enter the Rift area through any of the broken doors.
Clear out the Keepers that spawn upon first entry.
The wall to the Sacred Place will be open after clearing the Keepers.

steps.name: placeGateworms
steps.summary: Place the Gateworms on the pedestals in the Sacred Place.
notes: Place the Gateworms on the two pedestals accessible on the main floor.
Walls will rise, allowing you to wall-run to the other side.
Place the remaining two Gateworms on the other pedestals.

steps.name: completeFinalRitual
steps.summary: Complete the final ritual to unlock Pack-a-Punch.
notes: Place the Summoning Key on the central altar in the Sacred Place.
Survive the ritual; the Shadowman will reveal his true intentions.
The Pack-a-Punch machine will become available.
The skybox will change, and a giant Apothicon will appear over the city.

steps.name: rideTramForSymbols
steps.summary: Ride the Tram to find the three symbols for unlocking the Apothicon Egg.
notes: Ride the Tram to different districts and look out the windows for hidden symbols.
Symbols are visible through red backlit windows.
Note the symbols and their patterns.

steps.name: unlockApothiconEgg
steps.summary: Unlock the Apothicon Egg by zapping the correct symbols in Beast Mode.
notes: In the Rift area, enter Beast Mode.
Zap the three symbols on the wall that match those seen from the Tram.
If done correctly, the wall will dissolve, revealing the Apothicon Egg.

steps.name: collectApothiconEgg
steps.summary: Collect the Apothicon Egg from the statue in the Rift.
notes: Interact with the statue to take one of the Eggs.
Each player can take an Egg.

steps.name: findApothiconStatues
steps.summary: Locate the four Apothicon statues for charging the Egg.
notes: Statue Locations:
- Footlight District alleyway under the Perk Machine.
- Canals District behind Ruby Rabbit stairs.
- Waterfront District in the destroyed building.
- Rift area opposite the Egg statue.

steps.name: chargeEggAtStatue1
steps.summary: Charge the Apothicon Egg at Statue 1.
notes: Place the Egg on one of the statues.
Kill 12 zombies nearby to charge it.
The Egg will glow white when charged.

steps.name: chargeEggAtStatue2
steps.summary: Charge the Apothicon Egg at Statue 2.
notes: Repeat the process at a different statue.
Place the Egg and kill 12 zombies nearby.

steps.name: chargeEggAtStatue3
steps.summary: Charge the Apothicon Egg at Statue 3.
notes: Repeat the process at another statue.
Place the Egg and kill 12 zombies nearby.

steps.name: chargeEggAtStatue4
steps.summary: Charge the Apothicon Egg at Statue 4.
notes: Repeat the process at the final statue.
Place the Egg and kill 12 zombies nearby.
The Egg will glow blue when fully charged.

steps.name: obtainApothiconSword
steps.summary: Return the charged Egg to obtain the Apothicon Sword.
notes: Go back to the statue in the Rift where you got the Egg.
Place the charged Egg to receive the Apothicon Sword.

steps.name: meetKeeperForArchOvum
steps.summary: Receive the Arch-Ovum from your character's Keeper.
notes: Go to your character's ritual site.
Interact with the ghostly Keeper to receive the Arch-Ovum.

steps.name: findArchOvumCircle1
steps.summary: Locate and complete Arch-Ovum ritual at Circle 1.
notes: Circle Locations:
- Footlight District in front of the Burlesque.
- Canals District near Ruby Rabbit.
- Waterfront District in front of The Anvil Gym.
- Junction near Easy Street entrance.
Place the Arch-Ovum on a red ritual circle.
Defeat the Margwas that spawn.

steps.name: findArchOvumCircle2
steps.summary: Complete Arch-Ovum ritual at Circle 2.
notes: Repeat the process at a different circle.
Place the Arch-Ovum and defeat the Margwas.

steps.name: findArchOvumCircle3
steps.summary: Complete Arch-Ovum ritual at Circle 3.
notes: Repeat the process at another circle.
Place the Arch-Ovum and defeat the Margwas.

steps.name: findArchOvumCircle4
steps.summary: Complete Arch-Ovum ritual at Circle 4.
notes: Repeat the process at the final circle.
Place the Arch-Ovum and defeat the Margwas.

steps.name: upgradeApothiconSword
steps.summary: Upgrade your Apothicon Sword to the Reborn Sword.
notes: Return to your character's ritual site.
Interact with the Keeper to exchange your sword for the upgraded Reborn Sword.

steps.name: activateFlagStep
steps.summary: Begin the 'Capture the Flag' step.
notes: Go to Nero's ritual site and interact with the open book on the ground.
A flag will appear near the portal to the Rift.
Pick up the flag; zombies will temporarily despawn.

steps.name: defendFlagInJunction
steps.summary: Defend the flag at two spots in the Junction.
notes: Carry the flag to the purple circle near Stamin-Up in the Junction.
Place and defend the flag from Insanity Elementals and the Shadowman.
After the chime, pick up the flag and move to the next circle near Easy Street.
Defend the flag again, then take it to Nero's ritual site.

steps.name: defendFlagInCanals
steps.summary: Defend the flag at two spots in the Canals District.
notes: Repeat the process in the Canals District.
Carry the flag to the purple circles and defend it.
After defending both spots, take the flag to the ritual site.

steps.name: defendFlagInFootlight
steps.summary: Defend the flag at two spots in the Footlight District.
notes: Repeat the process in the Footlight District.
Defend the flag at both purple circles.
Deliver the flag to the ritual site afterward.

steps.name: defendFlagInWaterfront
steps.summary: Defend the flag at two spots in the Waterfront District.
notes: Repeat the process in the Waterfront District.
Defend the flag at both purple circles.
Take the flag to the ritual site when done.

steps.name: trapShadowman
steps.summary: Trap the Shadowman during the final ritual in the Sacred Place.
notes: Go to the Sacred Place in the Rift area.
Each player interacts with their pedestal to summon the Keepers.
The Keepers will remove the Shadowman's shield.
Shoot the Shadowman as he teleports.
When he's near the altar, interact with it to trap him.

steps.name: startFinalStep
steps.summary: Begin the final step to avert the apocalypse.
notes: A giant Gateworm appears in the sky.
Kill purple Margwas to reactivate Beast Mode pedestals.
Players will frequently become 'infected'; cleanse by touching white wisps.

steps.name: enterBeastMode
steps.summary: Enter Beast Mode after reactivating pedestals.
notes: Kill Margwas until enough pedestals are active.
Enter Beast Mode using the pedestals with blue flames.
Beast Mode is infinite during this step but can be depleted by hazards.

steps.name: shockElectricalBoxes
steps.summary: In Beast Mode, shock the electrical boxes in the Tram Stations.
notes: Three players in Beast Mode need to shock the electrical boxes in each Tram Station:
- Waterfront District.
- Footlight District.
- Canals District.
This electrifies the Tram rails.

steps.name: callAndRideTram
steps.summary: Call the Tram to run over the Giant Gateworm.
notes: A player calls the Tram at any station.
The Tram hits the Gateworm, temporarily removing it.

steps.name: shockKeepers
steps.summary: In Beast Mode, shock the Keepers in the Junction.
notes: With the Gateworm gone, quickly go to the Junction.
Shock the three Keepers around the summoning table.
If successful, a cutscene will play.

steps.name: enjoyEndingCutscene
steps.summary: Watch the ending cutscene and complete the Easter Egg.
notes: Congratulations! You've completed the Shadows of Evil Easter Egg.
Enjoy the ending cutscene.
